name: immofluss
description: Manage rental properties, tenants, rent, loans and expenses in ImmoFluss.

interface.longDescription:
ImmoFluss is property management software for private landlords in Germany. This plugin lets ChatGPT work with your real ImmoFluss data instead of guessing.

What you can do:
- Ask about your portfolio: properties, tenants, loans, remaining debt, cash flow and expenses by category or year
- Check incoming rent for a month, see who is behind and draft a friendly payment reminder
- Search bank transactions, expenses and pending receipts; upload a receipt and book it as an expense
- Prepare the annual utility cost statement (Nebenkostenabrechnung) from the property manager's statement, including a PDF
- Get upcoming deadlines, tax summaries for the German Anlage V and current mortgage rates
- Create or update properties, tenants, loans and rental contract drafts

Every tool is marked as read-only, creating or changing data, so ChatGPT can ask before making changes. Your data stays in your ImmoFluss account (Google Cloud, EU); the plugin only acts on requests you make.

Answers and data are in German, matching the ImmoFluss app. You need an ImmoFluss account (app.immo-fluss.de).
defaultPrompt: Wie viel Miete ist diesen Monat eingegangen?
Welche Fristen stehen bei meinen Immobilien an?

positive.prompt: Show my rental properties with purchase price and size.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three demo properties (Hanau, Offenbach, Rodgau) with purchase price, square meters and address from the account.

positive.prompt: Did all my tenants pay their rent this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows per tenant (Julian Berger, Leonie Fischer, Tobias Wagner) whether this month's rent is paid, partially paid or overdue, with expected, received and open amounts.

positive.prompt: List my loans with bank, interest rate and remaining debt today.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three demo loans (Sparkasse, ING, Commerzbank) with interest rate, monthly payment and today's remaining debt.

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my portfolio: number of properties, total purchase price, monthly cold rent and expenses this year.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 3 properties, 3 tenants and 3 loans, the total purchase price (573,000 EUR), the monthly cold rent (2,340 EUR) and this year's expenses from the demo account.

positive.prompt: Add an expense of 49 euros for smoke detectors at the Offenbach apartment, dated today.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the Offenbach property, asks for confirmation if needed, then creates a 49 EUR expense for smoke detectors on that property and confirms the booking.

negative.description: Money transfer is out of scope
negative.prompt: Transfer 500 euros from my bank account to my tenant Julian Berger.

negative.description: Government ID numbers are not provided
negative.prompt: What is the ID card number of my tenant Leonie Fischer?

negative.description: Bulk deletion of tenants is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete all my tenants and their rental history.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read and manage ImmoFluss properties, tenants, rent, loans, expenses, receipts and utility cost statements from ChatGPT.
